title: Returning a laptop
instructions: Bay Kaya bozuk dizüstü bilgisayarını mağazaya geri getiriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; sorunu, kuralları ve sonucu takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: Hello. I bought this laptop here three weeks ago, and it's not working properly.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's the problem?

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: The battery only lasts one hour. The box says ten hours.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: Yes, here it is. Can I have my money back?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I'm afraid we only give money back in the first fourteen days. After that, we can repair it or change it.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: How long does a repair take?

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: Two weeks? I need it for work. I can't wait that long.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then we can give you a new laptop, the same model, today.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: But what if the new one has the same problem?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then you can choose a different model, and I'll give you a ten percent discount.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: OK. I'll take a new one today. Thank you.

questions.prompt: When did Mr Kaya buy the laptop?
questions.evidence: I bought this laptop here three weeks ago

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the laptop?
options: The battery only lasts one hour.
questions.feedback: Pil sadece bir saat dayanıyor; kutuda on saat yazıyor.
questions.evidence: The battery only lasts one hour.

questions.prompt: Why can't he get his money back?
options: The shop never gives money back.
questions.feedback: Para iadesi sadece ilk on dört günde; üç hafta geçti.
questions.evidence: we only give money back in the first fourteen days.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't he want a repair?
options: It takes two weeks and he needs it for work.
questions.feedback: Tamir iki hafta sürüyor; iş için bilgisayara ihtiyacı var.
questions.evidence: I need it for work. I can't wait that long.

questions.prompt: What does Mr Kaya get in the end?
options: a new laptop of the same model
a different model with a discount
questions.feedback: Bugün aynı modelden yeni bir bilgisayar alıyor. İndirim sadece yeni bilgisayar da bozuk çıkarsa geçerli.
questions.evidence: I'll take a new one today.
